description: Chains pay for enabling their network on Goldsky infrastructure. This covers the base cost of keeping the network online regardless of individual user consumption.

subgraphs.note: Base $36K/yr, can discount to $20K/yr floor. Chain also pays for ALL entity storage consumed by their entire ecosystem (all sponsored/approved teams).
chain_pays_for: All entity storage for sponsored/approved ecosystem teams
subgraphs.storage_rates: Same tiered rates as scale plan (100K–10M: $0.0053/hr, 10M+: $0.0014/hr)

mirror.note: Base $36K/yr, can discount to $20K/yr floor. Chain pays for full unfiltered database storage of all data on the network — not filtered by what individual users consume.
chain_pays_for: Full unfiltered database storage for the network (all data types: blocks, logs, traces, transactions, etc.)
mirror.storage_note: Use the dataset-sizes tool to get current total storage for a network. Individual users may filter (e.g., only logs), but the chain pays for everything.

key_distinction: Individual teams pay usage-based pricing for what they consume (filtered data). Chains pay for the full unfiltered storage/compute cost of keeping the network available on Goldsky, regardless of individual consumption patterns.
